name: Happy Path — Direct Debit Setup and First Collection
description: PER-001 sets up a Direct Debit Instruction (DDI) via the mobile app. AUDDIS validation succeeds. BACS confirms the mandate (active). Originator submits first collection at D-2. Account balance is sufficient at D-0. Account is debited. Customer receives post-collection confirmation. Journey covers PH-046 through PH-050.

steps.action: Navigate to Direct Debits → Add Direct Debit. Enter: originator name (BRITISH GAS), SUN (123456), reference (BGS-001234567), amount_type (variable), first collection date (2026-05-15)
Display DDI summary for review: originator BRITISH GAS, variable amount, first collection 15 May 2026. Prompt customer to complete SCA.
Complete SCA (FIDO2 biometric — authorises DDI setup)
POST /sca/validate { assertion, context: 'direct_debit_setup', originator_sun: '123456' }
200 OK { sca_assertion_ref: 'sca-uuid', valid: true }

POST /payments/v1/direct-debits { account_id, originator_name: 'BRITISH GAS', originator_sun: '123456', reference: 'BGS-001234567', amount_type: 'variable', first_collection_date: '2026-05-15', sca_assertion_ref }
steps.note: Persona → Channel → CAP-003 Payment Operations API. Never Persona → SVC-009 directly.

steps.action: 202 Accepted { ddi_id: 'a1b2c3d4-...', status: 'pending', poll_url: '/payments/v1/direct-debits/a1b2c3d4-...' }
steps.note: SVC-009 creates ENT-034 (DirectDebitInstruction, status=pending). Internally initiates AUDDIS validation and BACS submission.

steps.action: Publish DirectDebitInstructionCreated (EVT-069) { ddi_id, account_id, originator_name, originator_sun, amount_type: variable, setup_channel: digital }
Write EVT-069 to WORM audit log
Show 'Your Direct Debit is being set up' confirmation screen.
Submit AUDDIS 0N (new instruction) to Vocalink: sort code, account number, originator SUN, reference
steps.note: SVC-009 validates modulus check, originator SUN, no duplicate DDI, then submits AUDDIS 0N

steps.action: AUDDIS acceptance acknowledged — processing within BACS cycle
BACS ADDACS confirmation received: DDI registered, bacs_reference assigned (e.g. 'BACS-DD-2026-04-15-001')
steps.note: Confirmation received within BACS processing cycle (T+1 to T+3 working days typical)

steps.action: Publish DirectDebitInstructionValidated (EVT-070) { ddi_id, account_id, originator_name, bacs_reference: 'BACS-DD-2026-04-15-001', status: 'active' }
steps.note: SVC-009 updates ENT-034.status = active, records bacs_reference

steps.action: Consume EVT-070 — update account management state: DDI active and visible in customer dashboard
Consume EVT-070 — dispatch DDI confirmation notification to customer (push + email): 'Your Direct Debit to BRITISH GAS is now active. BACS ref: BACS-DD-2026-04-15-001. [DD Guarantee summary]'
Write EVT-070 to WORM audit log
Customer receives: push notification + email confirming DDI active. DD Guarantee rights disclosed.
BACS collection file received from originator at D-2 (13 May 2026): collection instruction for £87.50, collection_date 15 May 2026
steps.note: Originator submits BACS collection file to Vocalink at D-2. SVC-009 receives and processes.

steps.action: Publish DirectDebitCollectionSubmitted (EVT-071) { collection_id, ddi_id, account_id, originator_name: 'BRITISH GAS', amount: 87.50, collection_date: '2026-05-15', submission_date: '2026-05-13' }
Consume EVT-071 — surface pending collection in customer upcoming transactions view
Consume EVT-071 — dispatch advance notice notification: 'BRITISH GAS will collect £87.50 on 15 May 2026'
Write EVT-071 to WORM audit log
Publish DirectDebitDebitRequested — cross-capability event on D-0 (15 May 2026): { collection_id, account_id, amount: 87.50 }
steps.note: Cross-capability async event from CAP-003 (SVC-009) to CAP-001 (SVC-001). SVC-009 does NOT call SVC-001 directly.

steps.action: Consume DirectDebitDebitRequested — check account balance (£312.00 available >= £87.50) — debit account ledger £87.50
Publish AccountDebited { account_id, amount: 87.50, debit_type: 'direct_debit', collection_id, debit_date: '2026-05-15' }
Consume AccountDebited — update ENT-035.status = collected
Publish DirectDebitCollectionProcessed (EVT-072) { collection_id, ddi_id, account_id, originator_name: 'BRITISH GAS', amount: 87.50, collection_date: '2026-05-15', status: 'collected' }
Consume EVT-072 — dispatch post-collection notification: 'BRITISH GAS collected £87.50 on 15 May 2026'
Write EVT-072 to WORM audit log
Customer sees £87.50 debit in transaction feed and receives push notification confirming collection.

timing_notes.ddi_setup_to_active: T+1 to T+3 working days (BACS AUDDIS processing cycle). Steps 1-17.
timing_notes.advance_notice_to_customer: D-2 (2 working days before collection). Steps 19-23.
timing_notes.collection_processing_d0: Within BACS D-0 settlement window (4-hour SLA). Steps 24-31.
